name: ESO 347-G017 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 347-G017, a dwarf galaxy in the Sculptor Group, seen by Hubble.
label: eso347g017-hubble
story: A little-studied dwarf galaxy of the Sculptor Group, whose glowing clouds of gas around young stars have been used to measure what it is made of. Hubble visited it in a campaign to image every known nearby galaxy.

claims.text: ESO 347-G017 is a dwarf galaxy in the Sculptor Group
ESO 347-G017 is also catalogued as PGC 71466
Oxygen abundances of ESO 347-G017 were measured from its H II regions
ESO 347-G017 was a target of Hubble program 15922, Every Known Nearby Galaxy
